steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Sedentary Lifestyle: A way of living that involves little or no physical activity, characterised by prolonged periods of sitting or lying down during waking hours. A person with a sedentary lifestyle does not meet the recommended levels of physical activity for health. | Obesity: A medical condition where a person has excess body fat to the extent that it may have a negative effect on their health. Obesity is commonly defined as having a BMI (Body Mass Index) of 30 or above. | PE Exam Tips — Sedentary Lifestyle and Obesity: 1.
